articles.title: China sees record panda bond issuance in 2026 as foreign borrowers pile in
articles.summary: Foreign governments, international banks and multinational companies are increasingly tapping China's domestic bond market, as panda bond issuance hit a record high in the first five months of the year.  A total of 11 entities sold 14 panda bonds - yuan-denominated debt instruments issued by foreign entities in mainland China's onshore market - worth 26.64 billion yuan (US$3.7 billion) in May, up 246 per cent from a year earlier and the highest level on record for the month, according to data...
